name: github-workflows-evidence
description: Reads what an organisation's GitHub Actions workflows run (triggers, actions used, first words of commands), for github-dependency-scan-check. GET only on api.github.com, bounded.

AUTH_HEADER.description: 'Bearer ' and a vault reference to a GitHub App installation token: 'Bearer vault://github_app:<owner>'. The controller mints it at dispatch. Grant the installed copy that exact path (it has no default grant).

OWNER.description: The GitHub organisation (or user) the App is installed on.

setup_instructions.title: Install the GitHub App
setup_instructions.detail: On the organisation, with the repository permissions "Contents: read" and "Actions: read" and nothing else.

setup_instructions.title: Configure and grant
setup_instructions.detail: Set AUTH_HEADER and OWNER on the node, and grant the installed copy exactly github_app:<owner>.
